description: This file defines the MemoryStreamQueueGrain class, which implements a storage queue for event data in Orleans. It supports enqueueing and dequeueing operations, manages a maximum event count, and participates in grain migration with hydration and dehydration methods.

classes.name: MemoryStreamQueueGrain
classes.description: A grain that acts as a memory-based event queue supporting enqueue and dequeue operations, with migration participation.

methods.name: Enqueue
methods.description: Adds a MemoryMessageData item to the queue, assigning it a sequence number, and throws an exception if the queue exceeds MaxEventCount.

methods.name: Dequeue
methods.description: Removes up to maxCount items from the queue and returns them as a list.
